newsitem.title: GREECE: ATHLETICS-PROFILE OF WORLD MEN'S 5,000 METRES CHAMPION KOMEN.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-PROFILE OF WORLD MEN'S 5,000 METRES CHAMPION KOMEN.

text.p: Profile of Daniel Komen, who won the world men's 5,000 metres title on Sunday.

Missed selection for last year's Olympics but had a remarkable 1996 season, breaking Algerian Noureddine Morceli's 3,000 metres world record with a mark of seven minutes 20.67 seconds in September in Rieti, Italy, and winning the overall Grand Prix title.
Ran a year's best of 12:48.98 for the 5,000 last June in Rome. Holds four of the six fastest times ever.
One of 13 children. Used to run 20 kms a day to school and back home from the age of seven. Competed in a 10,000 metres race when he was eight.
